description: Order a lab test for patient Kent Zemlak (DOB: February 16, 2001) in NOSH ChartingSystem. Log in as demo_provider (password: Provider1234!, practice: Hillside Family Medicine). Navigate to Kent's patient chart and open the Orders section. Click the '+' dropdown and select 'Add Lab Order'. Note: NOSH requires an active encounter to add lab orders — if redirected to an encounter form with the message 'Creating an encounter first to add a new order', fill in the encounter details (Chief Complaint and Template are required) and save to create the encounter. In the lab order form, type 'Complete Blood Count (CBC)' in the 'Lab Test(s)' text area (the required field marked with a red border) and save the order.
